query: Consider the Sub-Saharan African economy with the slowest real GDP growth in 2013. How adequate were its foreign exchange reserves against external financing risks that year? Judge it with the simple single-ratio cover tests (imports, short-term external debt, broad money), counting reserves including gold, short-term external debt on original maturity and World Bank WDI data.

text.text: Identifies that the answer uses the traditional reserve-adequacy rules of thumb: reserves of at least 3 months of imports, full (100 percent) cover of short-term external debt (Greenspan-Guidotti), and about 20 percent of broad money.
text.accept: full = names the traditional / rule-of-thumb reserve adequacy metrics (imports, short-term debt, M2); acceptable alternative: IMF ARA risk-weighted metric if the three traditional metrics are also computed; no = reserves to GDP only, or a debt sustainability analysis

text.text: States 3 of 3 benchmarks met (imports cover met, short-term-debt cover met, broad-money cover met)
text.accept: full = benchmark verdicts match the recomputation

data.text: Uses WDI total reserves, imports of goods and services, short-term external debt, M2 as % GDP and GDP in current US dollars.

computation.text: Reserves cover of Central African Republic imports in 2013 = 5.9 months (benchmark 3)
computation.accept: full = within 0.3 months (total reserves incl. gold over imports of goods and services / 12)

computation.text: Reserves as a share of short-term external debt = 169 % (benchmark 100)
computation.accept: full = within 5 percent of the value (min 10 pp); short-term debt on original maturity

computation.text: Reserves as a share of broad money (M2 = M2/GDP x GDP in US dollars) = 44.8 % (benchmark 20)
computation.accept: full = within 5 percent of the value (min 2 pp)

assembled_from: IMF (2011) Assessing Reserve Adequacy, traditional-metrics section
provenance.selection: non-high-income countries, 2012-2022, all five series present, 0.5 months / 15 pp / 4 pp away from each benchmark; seeded draw; one per country

gold_report_note: No corpus country report is the gold source; recomputed from frozen WDI. Cross-check against WDI own months-of-imports series failed (that series excludes gold, 443 of 5942 country-years match), so it is not used as a published value.
distractors: IMF risk-weighted ARA composite metric (needs exchange-rate regime, portfolio liabilities)
predicate: the Sub-Saharan African economy with the slowest real GDP growth in 2013
